notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
We released an update to fix the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a player to have negative shot power when they either used a bomb or lost a life.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the boss to disappear when using a continue which required a pause and unpause to reappear.
[*] Fixed an issue with either the health and/or lives not resetting when using a continue.
[*] Fixed an issue where the number of bombs used does not go up when using one.
[*] Fixed a display issue where the credits counter would not change when using a continue.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 Update
notes.content: We fixed another player 2-related issue, this time in the setup screen when they are selecting their character. For some reason, the second controller could not use the A button to confirm. We have since fixed this problem.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Update
notes.content: We released a small patch to fix an issue with the second player's stats displaying the first player's stats instead. We hope you excel!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, players. We hope you are doing well.

I'm announcing that the title screen has been updated to include two links. The first allows you to view the game's repository on GitHub, and the other enables you to access Drillipedia, the official wiki of Drillimation Danmaku Universe.

I'm working to get the game playable in a web browser, but we're running into issues.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
Hello, players.

It's been a month since I last did an update. I was busy setting up the engine for my next project. We've been listening to your feedback and helping us improve the game. This update makes the following changes:
[list]
[*]FPS is now displayed.
[*]Player character now moves faster.
[*]Dream items now fall every time a boss segment is depleted.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.content: We've got one final update for 2023 that will help you kickstart 2024. We made a quick change to lower the gravity speed of items, making point, power, bomb, and life items easier to collect.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
We've made an update to balance the game based on feedback. Some of the changes we made are:

[list]
[*]Marisa's special attack has been made more reliable.
[*]Classic mode has been balanced to give players extra lives instead of bombs for score in Chuhou Joutai mode.
[*]Invincibility is now given for five seconds when using bombs.
[*]Kagami Ochiai's attacks during the fourth stage have become more balanced.
[*]Fixed a few dependency issues involving Youmu's scenario in the Extra stage (thanks Yeashie).
[/list]

We will not be making any changes between December 20 and 27 due to a holiday break.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Greetings players. It's been nearly 24 hours since the release of the game and we are patching out a few issues encountered. Also, please do not post information about bugs in the reviews, please report them on the game's GitHub page.

Below are the bugs we have fixed:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would crash after a run. The error involved attempting to draw a non-existent sprite, and a failsafe has been added to prevent this.
[*]Fixed an issue whenever a second player would join mid-game, a clone of the player 1 character would also spawn.
[/list]
